title: Organisations with findings in the City data that other public bodies also pay
question: When the City’s own record raises a question about an organisation, who else is paying it?
finding: 27 organisations that carry an official finding, a charged or proven case, or (for nonprofits) three or more warning signs in the City data also appear in 51 board items of other bodies, $63.6 million as read; the largest with an official finding at the City is Sunset Scavenger Company, with 2 items at City College worth $271,000.
how: Organisations on this file’s warning-sign map that carry an official finding or a charged or proven case, and nonprofits with three or more signs, are searched for by full name in the other bodies’ item text, and the items are added up per organisation and body.
limits: These are board agenda items and resolutions: a ceiling the board was asked to authorise, not a payment, and the dollar figure is the first one a parser found in the text. An item on an agenda may have been amended or withdrawn. Each body is legally separate from the City. A finding at the City says nothing about the organisation’s work for another body; this table shows only where one audit would not see the other’s money. Large firms and universities match by name across many unrelated contracts.
